title: Crash when deleting an unused file on Steam Godot 4.5.1
body:
### Tested versions

Tested on Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.official on Steam (f62fdbde15035c5576dad93e586201f4d41ef0cb), but it happened on an earlier 4.4.? standalone Linux version as well from what I remember

Current crash: Steam version, Ubuntu 25.10, 64GB RAM, Ryzen 7 9800X3D, Radeon RX 9070 XT
4.4.? crash: Standalone from godot website, Ubuntu 25.10, 32 GB RAM, i9 14900hx, rtx 4080 mobile



### System information

Ubuntu 25.10, 64GB RAM, Ryzen 7 9800x3D, Radeon RX 9070XT

### Issue description

Title and repro steps should be self-explanatory
